functions.name: Do
functions.summary: Do calls f with a copy of the parent context with the given labels added to the parent's label map. Goroutines spawned while executing f will inherit the augmented label-set. Each key/value pair in labels is inserted into the label map in the order provided, overriding any previous value for the same key. The augmented label map will be set for the duration of the call to f and restored once f returns.

functions.name: Labels
functions.summary: Labels takes an even number of strings representing key-value pairs and makes a [LabelSet] containing them. A label overwrites a prior label with the same key. Currently only the CPU and goroutine profiles utilize any labels information. See https://golang.org/issue/23458 for details.

functions.name: Lookup
functions.summary: Lookup returns the profile with the given name, or nil if no such profile exists.

functions.name: NewProfile
functions.summary: NewProfile creates a new profile with the given name. If a profile with that name already exists, NewProfile panics. The convention is to use a 'import/path.' prefix to create separate name spaces for each package. For compatibility with various tools that read pprof data, profile names should not contain spaces.

functions.name: Profiles
functions.summary: Profiles returns a slice of all the known profiles, sorted by name.

functions.name: SetGoroutineLabels
functions.summary: SetGoroutineLabels sets the current goroutine's labels to match ctx. A new goroutine inherits the labels of the goroutine that created it. This is a lower-level API than [Do], which should be used instead when possible.

functions.name: StartCPUProfile
functions.summary: StartCPUProfile enables CPU profiling for the current process. While profiling, the profile will be buffered and written to w. StartCPUProfile returns an error if profiling is already enabled.

functions.name: StopCPUProfile
functions.summary: StopCPUProfile stops the current CPU profile, if any. StopCPUProfile only returns after all the writes for the profile have completed.

functions.name: WithLabels
functions.summary: WithLabels returns a new [context.Context] with the given labels added. A label overwrites a prior label with the same key.
